register.labelZh: BOX 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: box somebody in 可以描述規則、承諾或決定令某人幾乎沒有自由採取行動。；box somebody or something in 可以表示車輛、人物或物件被圍住或堵住，因而無法移動。；box something up 適合用來談論搬屋、收納物品或把東西寄給別人。；在新聞和工作英語中，box somebody in 通常表示選擇受到限制；在日常情境中，它通常表示被實際堵住。
register.summaryEn: Box somebody in can describe rules, promises or decisions that leave a person with little freedom to act. Box somebody or something in can show that vehicles, people or objects are surrounded or physically blocked. Box something up is useful when discussing moving house, storing belongings or sending items to another person. In news and workplace English, box somebody in often concerns limited choices. In daily-life situations, it often describes being physically blocked.
